page.overview:
Who is Colti?

Admiral Colti was a Starfleet officer in the 2370s.

In 2373, Colti traveled to Deep Space 9 as one of the Federation observers of Bajor's entrance into the Federation. Odo originally assigned her quarters similar to those of Admiral Veta, but Worf was adamant that Colti receive better quarters than Admiral Veta, whom Colti outranked. ()
